evals.prompt: /foleon-cycle A new cycle started (2026-C5, 18 Aug to 26 Sep). Topics: PDF export, 2 weeks. Search relevance in ripley, 3 days. Editor polish, 1 week.
evals.expected_output: Parses the three topics and shows the parse back BEFORE asking anything. Flags 'Editor polish' as a grab-bag rather than interviewing it as a topic. Then batches intake questions (AskUserQuestion, ~4 at a time), scaled to appetite — the 3-day ripley topic gets fewer questions than PDF export. Creates the doc via cycle.py new. Does not create scopes or tasks for any topic missing a CYC-3 field.

evals.prompt: /foleon-cycle log yesterday: I touched about 8 files in fio, mostly the PDF extractor, and I decided to drop the nested-table support to a nice-to-have.
evals.expected_output: Logs the nested-table drop as a DECISION gate line (it is scope hammering) and marks that task with a leading ~. Does NOT log 'touched 8 files in fio' — that fails CYC-8 and is what git already records. Asks which scopes moved on the hill rather than inferring from the files. Writes only after showing the proposed line.

evals.prompt: /foleon-cycle I found out that fio's vite config needs the fio-local host alias or the editor won't boot. Add that to the cycle doc.
evals.expected_output: Declines to put it in the dev log: it is a durable project fact, so CYC-12 routes it to foleon-fio's references/knowledge.md, naming that skill. May note the discovery as a surprise-gate log line if it changed the cycle's work, but the fact itself does not live in the cycle doc.

evals.prompt: /foleon-cycle here's the ticket for the ambient context task: https://foleon.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-4360
evals.expected_output: Runs `cycle.py jira link --url https://foleon.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-4360 --task "<fragment>"` against the task the maintainer named. Does NOT guess which task the URL belongs to from a title match, and if the fragment is ambiguous, shows the candidates and asks. Then fetches the issue read-only (searchJiraIssuesUsingJql or getJiraIssue, fields summary + status), saves the payload to a file, and runs `cycle.py jira sync --from <file>` so the task takes Jira's title and status. Never calls a Jira write tool of any kind. Re-mirrors afterwards, since the doc changed. Reports the resulting title and status in one or two lines, without a menu of other flows.

evals.prompt: /foleon-cycle PROD-4357 is in QA now, can you tick it off in the doc and move it to Done in Jira?
evals.expected_output: Splits the request. Refuses the Jira half plainly and once — the maintainer writes every Jira transition themselves (CYC-18), and the connector exposes no transition tool to call — without moralising or offering a workaround. Does NOT tick the checkbox by hand either: a keyed task's completion comes from Jira's statusCategory, and QA is `indeterminate`, so the box stays unticked while the doc shows the status name QA. Offers to refresh via `cycle.py jira sync` after they move it in Jira. Does not treat 'QA' as done because it sounds late in the workflow.
